notes.title: [UPDATE] Hotfix - Patch 1.5
notes.content:
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Fixed faction details controller navigation (raid map).
[*] Removed an Xbox controller button showing on the raid map when playing with mouse & Keyboard.
[*] Fixed a possible softlock when disconnecting the controller during a loading screen.
[*] Fixed a crash occurring after moving a room or object placed in a save from before version 1.5.
[*] Fixed a hard lock when selecting the bathroom for objective 1.2 on a controller.
[*] Simplified room selection with a controller.
[*] Fixed Midrantir resigning in sandbox due to a behavior issue.
[*] Fixed weapon and tools storage after moving a workshop from one floor to another.

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*] Rooms may remain "under construction" in very specific cases.
[*] The Fire Book cannot be unlocked in sandbox mode.
[*] Some guards may keep their "poisoned" state indefinitely.
[/list]

notes.title: [UPDATE] Patch 1.5 is now LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/bd889671dca9d292092c4cae1a1ecc06e2509179.png[/img]

H-Hey Master.

As you asked (and to avoid more deadly accidents at work), we fixed some stuff around in the dungeon! Check out the details below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/d361ad1a575abd753568d025ebc0ec3790e7a0ac.png[/img]
[list] 
[*] Added gamepad controls (we still recommend playing with a mouse and a keyboard).
[*] Added an “unlock all” option when creating a new sandbox dungeon.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented salary payment while the camera was focused on another floor.
[*] Zangdar will no longer fire you for no reason.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/ceb96776c6bd94a11b968b5bae1dc4a0171cfe44.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where minions would freeze since version 1.3.
[*] Fixed a bug where minions would freeze after a spellcaster teleport.
[*] Fixed a bug where minions would freeze after starting an incursion.
[*] Fixed corrupted saves since version 1.4.
[*] Fixed objective 8.2 which blocks progress if the player hasn't built a PayPalantír.
[*] Fixed a bug preventing objects from being built inside rooms.
[*] Fixed a bug that blocked progress in mission 5.4 when a strike was in progress.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented players from sending minions into raids.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the player from sacrificing or firing some minions.
[*] Fixed a bug where the game would crash if the player clicked on a raid button REALLY fast.
[*] Fixed a hard-lock that randomly locked the game when sacrificing a minion.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the player from recruiting a cook during the tutorial.
[*] Fixed random crashes when saving the game.
[*] Fixed random crashes during incursions.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/62431d8a989443da8aaf77aebf62f54b433d8f19.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed tutorial on freeing prisoners.
[*] Fixed texts about the elf faction's raids.
[*] Fixed game-over screen.
[*] Fixed some texts overflowing from windows.
[*] Fixed text of objective 3.3.
[*] Fixed raid appraisal window not showing every minion initially assigned to the mission.
[*] Fixed typos on several texts.
[*] Carpets and Dividing Walls effects corrected.
[*] Text colors in market window corrected.
[*] Updated stairs icons.
[*] Updated teleportation window.
[*] Updated the tavern’s window to clarify its inner workings.
[*] Added a new help text on the recycling button (undead invocation).
[*] Added a new help text clarifying the inner workings of meal preparation/consumption (kitchen room).
[*] Added a new help text clarifying the inner workings of the tavern (tavern room).
[*] Added a text indicating when the maximum amount of a resource is reached.
[*] Added a new emote when prisoners reach their tipping point.
[*] Added an indication of current dungeon stocks in every stock object’s window.
[*] Removed a superfluous notification linked to the compost resource gauge.
[*] Rewrote traits indicating food preferences for clarification (added new ones when missing).
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/5895518479643160224fac8ac8527c20707c896a.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Updated difficulty options in sandbox mode.
[*] Changed unique minions unlock conditions in sandbox mode.
[*] Guards spend more time in their room when they have nothing else to do.
[*] Dirtiness propagates less quickly in corridors.
[*] Vampires eat less often.
[*] Elves fall into traps less often.
[*] Minions select in priority rooms on their floor.
[*] Fixed the domestics' behavior.
[*] Raised the amount of gold rewarded by raids.
[*] Raised damages dealt by status effects.
[*] Raised the amount of intel resource generated by torturing adventurers.
[*] Lowered the amount of resource stocked by storage units (50 > 20, except for compost, which remains at 50 per grave).
[*] Lowered the rate of propagation of the “dynamo” status effect.
[*] Lowered patience gained by Zangdar from having a prestigious room.
[*] Stopped the moral loss of minions when they discuss.
[*] Stopped the moral loss of minions when they request healing.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/4db95fc7354273cfddedf14e30ffc0367324828f.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed objects to be placed on reserved spaces.
[*] Removed a lot of reserved spaces on decorative objects.
[*] Fixed a lot of soft-locks and crashes when constructing.
[*] The Anti-Prophetic Containment Cupboard is now a specific decoration.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/2303214720ba25001649f6138698f7e987bfaea7.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed many visual glitches.
[*] Fixed door placement.
[*] The Grade 10 VFX is now only displayed on Grade 10 minions.
[*] Added missing animation on spies.
[*] Fixed invisible clients in tavern.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/fa670e23adfe07cfb88d790fba8d961a3f81aa94.png[/img][list]
[*] Fixed plenty of bugs linked to the spell casters’ teleportation.
[*] Necromancers cannot collect bodies while a fight is in progress anymore.
[*] Fixed numerous bugs linked to minions waiting for their salary.
[*] Fixed cultists’ behavior when the player asks for a sacrifice.
[*] Fixed duplicate trait on minions returning from raids.
[*] Fixed demons born of the sacrifice of dwarves.
[*] Fixed a bug teleporting guards at the dungeon’s entrance at the start of an incursion.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused artisans to become dirty quickly.
[*] Fixed a bug preventing minions returning from raid to benefit from relic effects.
[*] Fixed pharmagicians’ behavior: if they're all requesting for healing, they'll heal each other.
[*] Global optimization.
[*] Updated credits.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/08b97462f8b938a4f09c00f8f9cb3558393992da.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Some occasional cases of saves not loading properly.
[*] Some occasional cases of rooms staying “under construction” indefinitely.
[*] The game can crash when moving a room and its props if the player is on a save made before this patch. A hotfix for this issue should be released in the next few days, but until then, we recommend to avoid moving rooms in the Dungeon.
[/list]

We thank you kindly for your patience (and your restraint in inflicting whiplashes).

Your humble servants.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2005160/Naheulbeuks_Dungeon_Master/

notes.title: [UPDATE] Hotfix - Patch 1.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/3d9e1914999b2dddeaafc2ec260bf27c8fca9a52.png[/img]

Hello everyone! 

Here's a hotfix to correct some of the problems introduced by patch 1.4. We've also been able to fix a few other bugs that have come to light thanks to the save files you've sent us. 

[list]
[*] Fixed corrupted saves following the sacrifice of vampires (which shouldn’t have been sacrifice-able in the first place). 
[*] Fixed a soft-lock occurring when shifting focus between windows (in/out of game) during a dialogue. 
[*] Fixed some cases of never-ending construction. 
[*] Fixed demons getting stuck when following their cultist. 
[*] Fixed adventurers randomly getting stuck. 
[*] Fixed a soft-lock occurring when a victory screen is displayed before the end of an incursion. 
[*] Further reduced the amount of interns ‘consumed’ by vampires. 
[*] Fixed loss of focus when using movement keys (e.g. WASD) while naming a save file. 
[*] Fixed invincible enemies (they are no longer invincible).
[/list]

Thanks again for your help!

notes.title: [UPDATE] Patch 1.4 is LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/96ddeb4ab0f11c7f9fb75ffae8c898a7593c83a2.png[/img]

[h3]Hey everyone!

Naheulbeuk’s Dungeon Master Version 1.4 is now available! 

We'd like to thank all the players who have reported bugs and sent us their save files. This has helped us identify some of the more evasive bugs that haven’t yet been caught during our many (many) QA tests.

This patch addresses a number of issues that should no longer affect future playthroughs.

As always, do not hesitate to let us know of any issues you may encounter by reporting them [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2005160/discussions/0/3972799233030518665/] here.[/url]

We have the upcoming Winter Sale where you can buy the game with a 10% discount! Stay tuned!
[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2005160/Naheulbeuks_Dungeon_Master/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/d361ad1a575abd753568d025ebc0ec3790e7a0ac.png[/img]
[expand type=details]
[olist]
[*] Reworked Tavern & Workshop/NASCRAC economy.
[list]
[*] Lowered the cost of drinks and tied the number of incoming clients   to the dungeon’s reputation
and the tavern’s prestige (the number of sausages).
[*] Raised the minimum selling price of resources and the amount produced.
[*] The aim of these reworks is to reduce the predominance   of the tavern in the dungeon’s economy and to allow different strategies to prosper.
[/list]
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented certain raids from rewarding the correct amount of gold (basically, the amount gained from some raids has been increased).
[*] Drastically raised the price of unique props - acquiring these props should be more of a challenge.
[*] Reworked Zangdar’s behaviour by introducing new ways for his patience gauge to drop.
[*] Enhanced bank counter selection of minions.
[*] Fixed some issues with the way minions selected their meals:
[list]
[*] Sweets are now expected by minions rank 8 and up.
[*] Human cooks still produce Sweets from rank 6 and up.
[*] Fixed a bug that made Meat the default meal to choose for some origins.
[/list]
[*] Added an option in the builder menu to hide the locked props.
[*] Added an icon on raids rewarding the player with a grimoire, a relic or a prop.
[*] Added a button on the guard lockers’ interface linking to the employed minion.
[*] Added shortcuts to access major windows from the main interface:
[/olist] [list]
[*] click on the gold counter to access the Accounting screen
[*] click on the minion counter to access the HR screen
[/list]
[/expand]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/ceb96776c6bd94a11b968b5bae1dc4a0171cfe44.png[/img]
[expand type=details]
[olist]
[*] Fixed a crash occurring while paying salaries.
[*] Fixed a crash occurring when using a grimoire.
[*] Fixed a crash occurring when moving a prison cell.
[*] Fixed several other random crashes.
[*] Fixed some cases of saves not loading.
[*] Fixed a hard-lock occurring when adventurers entered the dungeon as it was edited by the player.
[*] Fixed a soft-lock preventing some players to place props.
[*] Fixed a bug preventing workers from building smaller rooms.
[*] Fixed a bug freezing minions and adventurers into place when editing the dungeon.
[*] Fixed a bug freezing minions and adventurers in place because of traps.
[*] Fixed a bug freezing minions and adventurers in place because of prison cells (please bear with us…).
[*] Fixed a bug freezing minions and adventurers in place during an incursion.
[*] Fixed a bug freezing minions and adventurers in place following an incursion stealing gold or relics.
[*] Fixed a bug freezing minions and adventurers in place because a cultist linked to a demon currently in combat decided to leave the dungeon.
[*] Fixed a bug freezing minions and adventurers in place because a combat started even before the whole group of adventurers entered the dungeon couldn’t end (as some of the adventurers already existed but weren’t in the dungeon).
[*] Fixed a bug freezing minions and adventurers in place because of cooks (yeah… cooking is hard).
[*] Fixed a bug moving then freezing (of course) demons into walls… At least they weren’t attacking minions.
[*] Fixed several hard-locks waaay too convoluted to mention in this patch note.
[*] Fixed the dwarves. They’re still annoying but at least they don’t start a strike on their own now.
[*] Speaking of strikes, fixed some of them never ending and not displaying correctly their end conditions.
[*] Fixed a hard-lock occurring during 6.1 (campaign mode).
[*] Fixed a hard-lock occurring during 6.4 (campaign mode): the necromancer’s menu could not be opened.
[*] Fixed a hard-lock occurring during 7.2 (campaign mode): the adventurers could not come.
[*] Fixed a hard-lock occurring during 7.9 (campaign mode): if the adventurers killed all the guards, they could end up stuck at the Golbargh’s floor.
[*] Fixed an error that could trigger a game over dialogue (getting fired by Zangdar) right after another story dialogue.
[/olist]
[/expand]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/f9fe4d3e5d8524fe584a80e34bf888b2bbb131dc.png[/img]
[expand type=details]
[olist]
[*] Added an option to invert the Y axis when moving the camera.
[*] Added feedback when recruiting someone.
[*] Removed the Raid Over notification and added it back as an alert.
[*] Fixed the sandbox option freezing the Golbargh’s gauge (it froze it empty instead of full… nasty!).
[*] Fixed the binding option menu sometime not saving edits (nastier!).
[*] Fixed the tavern’s income curve not displaying correctly (Accounting window).
[*] Fixed the Market window not displaying promo when it should.
[*] Fixed a mathematical error preventing from selling resources correctly.
[*] Fixed the position of a raid point on the map.
[*] Fixed information displayed on the game over screen.
[*] Changed the incursion alert.
[*] Improved the health bar of NPCs in combat.
[*] Changed the FPS display setting option Unlimited (to 120FPS).
[*] A LOT of UI, icons and 2D animation have been polished.
[*] Fixed the Library Room’s Help text (which was giving obsolete information, sorry about that…).
[*] Fixed a lot of inconsistencies in quotation marks usage.
[*] Fixed some texts that were not updated correctly after switching the game’s display language.
[*] Fixed a line which was said by Zangdar instead of Doris.
[*] Added a text explaining correctly how the Toc’s Hen works.
[*] Fixed inconsistencies in unlock texts.
[*] Added/tweaked some texts to clarify the way some of the game’s elements work.
[*] General text polish/revision.
[/olist]
[/expand]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/5895518479643160224fac8ac8527c20707c896a.png[/img]
[olist]
[*] Froze Cultists’ needs during a sacrifice.
[*] Fixed the torture gauge increasing way too fast even after the Torturer left the room.
[*] Fixed Astral Energy production (which was way too low).
[*] Reduced the speed at which Domestics levelled up.
[*] Changed some unique raids’ rewards.
[*] Lowered the moral gauge decrease rate and introduced some fixes in the way it was calculated.
[*] Enhanced the queue system (mostly in banks too).
[*] Raised the number of dwarves needed before the elves start a strike.
[*] Raised the health pool of unique minions: Draja, Orlof, Mel, Midranthir.
[*] Reduced the Vampires’ appetite. Some interns never had a chance...
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/4db95fc7354273cfddedf14e30ffc0367324828f.png[/img]
[olist]
[*] Fixed a bug allowing objects to be placed on the outside of the third floor.
[*] Fixed a bug not displaying the bank counters in some cases.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/9086dce3982cb4205218bad51472baca84634647.png[/img]

Hello Fellow Stewards,

We just updated the game (1.3) to fix some of your feedback, please find below the detailed patch notes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/a74ce773c9fce7f5a1820d894940d39f99b95dc6.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash occurring at the end of the campaign.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/04a2612edd2760407d55bff2b229955e590436a7.png[/img]
[olist]
[*] During the stairs tutorial, a hard-lock occurring when the “furniture” section is folded has been fixed.
[*] During the trap tutorial, a hard-lock occurring when the “traps” section is folded has been fixed.
[*] Extending a treasure room won't hard-lock the next construction at the same floor anymore.
[*] Several save corruption bugs fixed.
[*] Fixed an issue where destroying or selling a counter in the treasury while a banker was working on it could block the game.
[*] When the bathroom was modified, minions could be frozen.
[*] Fixed an issue where enemies tagged for imprisonment could never be imprisoned if torture had taken place beforehand.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/f9fe4d3e5d8524fe584a80e34bf888b2bbb131dc.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Yrfoul’s book was written in English when the game was in Polish.
[*] A note on how the tocs’hen works has been added in French and English (for the moment).
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/5895518479643160224fac8ac8527c20707c896a.png[/img]
[olist]
[*] Task priorities have been reworked
[list]
[*] Minions will satisfy their vital needs earlier (sleeping and eating).
[*] They'll look after their vital needs first, then their secondary needs, then they'll do one-off jobs like summoning a demon (at the player's command), and finally they'll do their daily work. It's worth noting that both going on strike and demanding their wages take precedence over any other need. Life is about having priorities anyway.
[*] Mass resignations are way less frequent. 
[/list]
[*] A small morale bonus will now be applied to all minions in the dungeon when they resign, to limit mass resignations. 
[*] When a minion is recruited, the filling level of their gauges has been raised.
[*] Now when a soldier is fighting, his needs are frozen.
[*] The "Bored" state no longer lowers the morale meter.
[*] The calculation of distances made by minions when they are searching for a room has been revised.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/fa670e23adfe07cfb88d790fba8d961a3f81aa94.png[/img]
[olist]
[*] Minions now run to the tavern (when they want have fun) instead of walking. And their needs keep on decreasing.
[*] Bankers had an erratic behavior when at their counter: they would stand up and sit, which made their needs decreasing. They should now remain sitting at their counter until all employee are paid. 
[*] Minions were not distributed correctly between the various treasure rooms.
[*] Selling a room from the Top View was causing errors.
[*] Fixed errors with the Radio.
[*] Same for the kitchen.
[*] Same for the prison.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/08b97462f8b938a4f09c00f8f9cb3558393992da.png[/img]
[olist]
[*] Campaign characters (Draja, Orolf, etc.) cannot be healed.
[*] More complex resignation issues need further investigation:
[list]
[*] Rank 6 minions only eat desserts, which should only be eaten by higher ranking minions (8+).
[*] Dishes-meals are not eaten enough, which prevents human cooks from ranking up as fast as other minions (as the meals are clogging the production line). Desserts being produced by human cooks from rank 6+ only, this limits the amount produced, thus making high ranking minions (whose needs are not met) resign faster.
[*] Overall food consumption currently favors meat. It needs to be more balanced.
[/list] [*] In the sandbox options, deactivating the Golbargh's gauge has the opposite effect: he is permanently on rampage mode.
[*] From greenraba : Adventurers are blocked and never enter the dungeon. Problem with steal food quest when the room targeted was being modified at the moment the adventurers spawned
[*] Dwarves might strike on their own, and never leave the "on strike" state if a minion tries to strike but gets stuck in place (like on the stairs).
[*] Cultists' needs are not paused during a sacrifice.
[*] The "Statuette of Gladeulfeurha" is not working as intended.
[*] Adventurers’ orcs don’t have a body.
[*] During the 7.9 quest, if the adventurers kill all of the guards, they may get stuck in Golbargh's lair.
[*] The torture gauge is quickly filling up, even if the Executioner leaves the prison.
[*] Pausing the game and selecting a raid will unpause it.
[*] Sacrificing Vampires does not spawn demons
[/olist] 

Thank you for your support.

notes.title: [FAQ] Tips & Tricks
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/594394df7f8d360cfe2fe3292dc88e330f2ac518.png[/img]

[h3]Hello Community,

We know that this may be the first time you have entered the Naheulbeuk universe. You can find all the Tips & Tricks at the end with a little summary of the universe!
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/0a6b95fdf0938d765afd84c7dfa0e70d3dd3b0dd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/1ee82dbb02c599d3d95b6fa9d7ad05c5169dfee5.png[/img]
[h3]Building[/h3]
[list]
[*] While the Tavern is being edited, it stops generating revenue. Consider pausing the game during this time to avoid unnecessary losses.
[*] Pay attention to every object's effects. Some can help you to keep your minions' spirit up.
[*] Avoid forcing your minions to climb four flights of stairs to reach basic amenities, like toilets...
[*] Look-out for new raids/new objects sold on the market. Some can be surprisingly useful.
[/list]
[h3]Minions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Orcs and Elves don't like each other. You could duplicate basic rooms (one kept clean and one worse than a teenage boy's bedroom) to accommodate both.
[*] Dwarves are annoying. Don't forget to furnish your rooms with dedicated furniture.
[*] If something goes wrong, try to look for clues in the HR and Accounting screens.
[*] Minions ranked 6 and higher prefer to eat sweet-meals.
[/list]
[h3]Fight[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tocs'hens only call for the closest guard-room and every undead on the floor. Place them with care.
[*] If adventurers are too strong for your guards, try accumulating armament with your workshops (may also require some dwarves).
[*] Avoid covering half your dungeon floor in traps, elves (and other minions) might trigger them.
[/list]
[h3]Others
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Any connected controller may interact strangely with the game (we're working on it).
[/list]
[h3]How to cancel a duplicate of a room?[/h3]
If you started building a room and want to restart from scratch, do not validate the room to stay in building mode and just right-click: you'll be able to delete the room entirely.

If you already built a room and want to delete it, click on the room and press the "sell room" button. Note that some rooms cannot be sold at the beginning of the game as they're needed for the tutorial, but you'll be able to sell them later in the campaign.

[h3]I found that there are some unkillable enemies, what should I do?[/h3]
Remove the relic from the pedestal and it should unblock the situation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/0a6b95fdf0938d765afd84c7dfa0e70d3dd3b0dd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/db66dc528babdeb167a630c0a0185f2170e98ad8.png[/img]
[h3]Management of the Tavern[/h3]

To manage your tavern properly, It's not enough to just put tables on it! Add more counters until there is a balance between the number of customers the number of people in the queue there.

[h3]Improve how your employees move around[/h3]
If you want people to be able to move around in your dungeon, you put in at least two or three staircases because, in fact, if people can't find a way to go somewhere that could be a reason why they're grumbling so there.

[h3]Why did my employees resign?[/h3]
If the resignations of your employees start at the start of each decade, it's probably because you don't have enough bankers and if there are too many people queuing up, they may get bored and leave. You should put many counters as you can and make sure it's the dwarfs who are working on it. Put them in beds, a canteen, a breaking room to make sure that they have a good working condition.

[h3]Why did minions not go to the room that I built?[/h3]
It could be because they're waiting for their salary, which is the minions' priority. But it could also be because the room is: 
[list]
[*] Too clean or too dirty (depending on the minions' origins)
[*] Too far away (build amenities close to where minions work!)
[*] Not prestigious enough for their expectations
[/list]
Also check the food stocks in the kitchens! Minions won't go to eat if there's a shortage of their preferred food.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/0a6b95fdf0938d765afd84c7dfa0e70d3dd3b0dd.png[/img]
[h2]This is my first time playing a game in the NBK universe, what should I know?[/h2]
[quote=author] The Dungeon of Naheulbeuk is a comedic high fantasy parody series created by John Lang. The series began in 2001 as a French-language online audio series following a party of adventurers in a fantasy role-playing game. John Lang wrote and produced the series, as well as performed most of the character voice. Following its success, the story was adapted into a comic series, a set of novels, and a video game with The Dungeon of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet of Chaos.

Naheulbeuk's Dungeon Master is a prequel to The Amulet of Chaos and offers a great starting point for newcomers to the series. All you need to know is that the villainous great sorcerer Zangdar has hired you, the Gobelin steward Reivax, to build, manage and defend the titular Dungeon of Naheulbeuk . Set years before the comic books’ storyline, the Dungeon of Naheulbeuk is in bad shape, close to bankruptcy, and falling apart and under the surveillance of the Dungeons Fund. It is now your job to rebuild everything, replenish the account’s balance, restore the reputation, recruit employees, and attract adventurers. [/quote]
Source: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2005160/discussions/0/3821914054522727969/]FAQ Steam[/url]

[h3]Stay tuned.
[/h3]

notes.title: [UPDATE] Launch Patch 1.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/5b78dc5ee74703cfca24a62ce159e01f0dc24dcb.png[/img]

Hi all!

As mentioned in our last communication we reviewed and monitored your concerns and feedback and have now deployed the patch 1.2 that will correct most of your issues. 

We are still investigating the minion's lack of autonomy and this issue will be corrected early next week following some testing from our team this weekend.

Thanks again for your patience & support. 

Please find the detailed patch not below : 

[h1]Crashes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added securities to avoid some crashes.
[/list]
[h1]Blockers[/h1]
[list]
[*] Drows go on a strike and want more torture but have a cell each to torture themself
[/list] [h3]Campaign 5.4:[/h3]
[list]
[*] If you fire the executioner before the adventurer enters the Dungeon, it will create a blocker
[*] The UI disappears when the prisoner is freed.
[*] Blocker in chapter 5.3 in the Polish version
[*] Teleportation cannot be cancelled.
[/list]

[h1]Texts and UI[/h1]
[list]
[*] Incorrect texts for unlocked Laundry (bathroom), Mudwash (bathroom).
[*] Some corrections to spelling mistake.
[*] Fixed missing lockey for demons in cultist ui
[*] New texts added for better understanding
[*] Credits updated.
[/list]
[h1]Balancing[/h1]
[expand type=details]
[list]
[*] Campaign 6.1: After placing the circle of invocation, the player has no corpses to invoke
[*] Price of props unlocked with the Warlock victory.
[*] Minions try to get paid in a treasure room with less waiting instead of all waiting in one place.
[*] Better balancing for bonus job for raids.
[*] Cooks gain more experience when they work.
[*] Updated NASCRAC formula.
[*] The card table is never used by minions or clients
[*] Updated minions' experience problems
[*] Updated experience required to level up adventurers.
[*] Raid: reduced prop/relic/grimoire drop-rate
[*] Fixed self-torture duration for drows
[*] Fixed undead troll health pool
[*] Fix banker experience gain
[/list]
[/expand]

notes.title: Upcoming Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/13476c51888f2bc888f3c2d2e346d97a65089154.png[/img]
 
Hello Fellow Stewards, 

Thanks immensely for your continued feedback and support! The dungeon is already cleaner and more profitable! 
 
Your participation has helped us to see how we can make this dungeon better! We are actively working on a series of balancing and bug fixes that will be arrived next week! 
 
Detailed patch notes will be available next week, but here are already what we are working hard on:

[list]
[*] Game's Stability in rare crashes instances 
[*] Balancing & Fine tuning for a better progression
[*] New texts added for better understanding
[*] Minions try to get paid in a treasure room with less waiting instead of all waiting in one place.
[*] Pathfinding & AI behavior is being investigated intensively 
[*] Builder optimization 
[*] Quality of life 
[/list]
Thanks again for your support and if you liked our game please post a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2005160/reviews/]review[/url] it helps a lot! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2005160/Le_Matre_du_Donjon_de_Naheulbeuk/

notes.title: Steam Playtest Extended
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/5a442b1dab2141d7e22560c050e28c6b25f53741.png[/img]

[h3]Dear trainee stewards, 
Thank you for answering our call! 
 
The dungeon's future will be magnificent thanks to your help! 
 
Our team has already been able to fix some of the problems reported. 
This is why a new version of the game will be available tomorrow. 
And the playtest is extended until Monday, September 11th. 
 
[b]But be careful! [/b]Unfortunately, you won't be able to keep your progress once the update is rolled out. 

You can continue playing on your ongoing save before until then, but please note that it won't be playable after the update.
 
New participants will be randomly selected from the list of those who registered last week.
Watch your inbox if you did.[/h3]

[h2][b]Found a bug in the dungeon?[/b][/h2]
[h3]Press [b]F7 [/b]and fill in the form with all the details![/h3]


[b]Changelog: [/b]
 
- It is no longer possible to sell the prison room or the cells during the jail tutorial. 
- Fixed a bug when salaries are paid at a counter shared between the treasure room and another room. 
- A demon now stops following its cultist when the latter is dismissed during a sacrificial summoning. The demon thus summoned immediately becomes hostile. 
- An executioner and his adventurer prisoner are no longer blocked when the prison cell in which he is excorted is destroyed during the travel. 
- Fixed a blocking issue during the necromancy tutorial, where you may have no necromancer when asked to select one from the list of minions. 
- Corrected an animation problem with guards due to a bug that caused them to keep their sword in their hand instead of putting it away. 
- Adjustments to the Golbargh's patience. 
- The maximum storage limit for the information resource is no longer limited to 100. 
- Fixed a bug that prevented a save from loading when it was made while a minion was in a specific behavior. 
- Fixed a bug after releasing a striker from prison. 
- The "Gzor's Cursed Hutch" raid now appears on the raid map only after the corresponding objective has been achieved. 
 

[b]Known issues: [/b]
 
- A crash inevitably occurs a few seconds after destroying or moving a treasure room, in cases where a counter is located between two rooms (door connecting the treasure room and an adjacent room) and a queue to pay salaries is in progress at this counter. Saves made after destroying or moving a treasure room corresponding to these criteria crash after waiting a few seconds in game. 
- Wall decorations and carpets are stackable. We are actively working on a correction for the game release. 
- The placement of rooms adjacent to a door leading to the outside causes inconsistencies in the construction rules. 
- Fighting can randomly result in a stalemate (e.g. an adventurer does not die, a guard is trapped on a staircase). Loading the last save often overcomes this problem.
